title: OneDrive and SharePoint: expiration for access on main sharing links
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and the documented general sharing controls, without presenting those controls as confirmed main-link policies. The only correction is minor: the governance checklist refers to sharing controls that have no corresponding table rows.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans expiration dates for Anyone and People in your organization access through main links to files and folders.
claims.quote: People can set expiration dates for “Anyone” and “People in your organization” access on the main link to files and folders in OneDrive and SharePoint.

claims.claim: Administrator policies will be able to require expiration.
claims.quote: Administrators can set policies to require expiration

claims.claim: Administrator policies will enforce a maximum access duration.
claims.quote: enforce a maximum access duration

claims.claim: OneDrive and SharePoint will have separate administrator policy settings.
claims.quote: with separate settings for OneDrive and SharePoint.

claims.claim: The main link remains when access expires.
claims.quote: When access expires, the main link remains

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Permissions granted directly to individuals are preserved when access expires.
claims.quote: permissions granted directly to individuals are preserved.

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap platforms are Android, Desktop, iOS, Mac, Mobile and Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Android", "Desktop", "iOS", "Mac", "Mobile", "Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap products are OneDrive, SharePoint and Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: "products": ["OneDrive", "SharePoint", "Microsoft 365"]

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn refers to the hero link as the main link.
claims.quote: In SharePoint PowerShell, set the default audience scope for the hero link, referred to as the main link, with DefaultMainLinkScope on a site.

claims.claim: Each OneDrive or SharePoint item has one hero link.
claims.quote: In OneDrive and SharePoint, each item has one hero link.

claims.claim: Users can change a hero link's audience and permissions without creating a new URL.
claims.quote: A hero link allows users to share a single link for an item, then change the audience and permissions for that link without needing to create a new URL.

claims.claim: Anyone links can be forwarded.
claims.quote: Anyone can forward the link

claims.claim: Anonymous use of Anyone links cannot be audited to a named user.
claims.quote: anonymous use can't be audited to a named user.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: People in your organization links can be forwarded to other directory members.
claims.quote: They can forward it to other members, but it doesn't work for guests or people outside the organization.

claims.claim: People in your organization links work for people signing in as Microsoft 365 directory members.
claims.quote: The link works for people who sign in as members of your Microsoft 365 directory.

claims.claim: Effective access reflects the highest permission from any source, so expiring main-link access does not remove independent grants.
claims.quote: A user's effective access is the highest permission granted by any source: direct access, a group, the parent folder or site, the hero link, or another sharing link.

claims.claim: Extra sharing links appear under Other links.
claims.quote: The sharing dialog lists them under Other links, along with links inherited from a parent folder.

claims.claim: Policies > Sharing in the SharePoint admin center contains the general Anyone-link expiration control, under advanced settings for Anyone links.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Policies, and then select Sharing. ... Advanced settings for "Anyone" links ... Link expiration - You can require all Anyone links to expire, and specify the maximum number of days allowed.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant in Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell accepts CoreAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays and OneDriveAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays to set the respective tenant-wide Anyone-link maximum lifetimes.
claims.quote: [-OneDriveAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays <Int32>] ... [-CoreAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays <Int32>] ... This is a tenant wide setting, and all geos will inherit the policy.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant in Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell accepts CoreOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays and OneDriveOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays to set the respective tenant-wide organisation-link maximum lifetimes.
claims.quote: ### -CoreOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays ... ### -OneDriveOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays ... This is a tenant wide setting, and all geos will inherit the policy.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has not documented an admin-centre setting for organisation-link expiry as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint organization sharing links expiration SharePoint admin center CoreOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays main link policies. Opened Manage sharing settings and Set-SPOTenant; no organisation-expiry UI path found.

claims.claim: CoreAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays accepts 1 through 730 days for SharePoint sites excluding OneDrive.
claims.quote: Specifies the maximum number of days before Anyone (anonymous) sharing links expire for all SharePoint sites (not including OneDrive sites). ... The value can be from 1 to 730 days.

claims.claim: OneDriveAnyoneSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays accepts 1 through 730 days for OneDrive sites.
claims.quote: Specifies the maximum number of days before Anyone (anonymous) sharing links expire for all OneDrive sites. ... The value can be from 1 to 730 days.

claims.claim: CoreOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays accepts 7 through 720 days for SharePoint sites excluding OneDrive.
claims.quote: Specifies the maximum number of days before organization sharing links expire for all SharePoint sites (not including OneDrive sites). ... The value can be from 7 to 720 days.

claims.claim: OneDriveOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays accepts 7 through 720 days for OneDrive sites.
claims.quote: Specifies the maximum number of days before organization sharing links expire for all OneDrive sites. ... The value can be from 7 to 720 days.

claims.claim: A SharePoint Administrator can change organisation-level sharing settings.
claims.quote: As a SharePoint Administrator in Microsoft 365, you can change the organization-level sharing settings for SharePoint and OneDrive.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant requires the SharePoint Online administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be a SharePoint Online administrator to run the cmdlet.

claims.claim: The Anyone link option requires the external sharing setting to be Anyone.
claims.quote: Anyone with the link ... This option is available only if your external sharing setting is set to Anyone.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: For the existing Anyone-link setting, a longer maximum preserves existing expiration times and a shorter maximum updates existing links.
claims.quote: If you change the expiration time, existing links keep their current expiration time if the new setting is longer, or update to the new setting if the new setting is shorter.

claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive main hero link expiration administrator policy default existing links notification renewal roadmap 571399. Read roadmap, sharing settings, shareable-links and Set-SPOTenant; no arrival default stated for this change.

claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive main sharing link expiration licensing prerequisites price meter plan. Read roadmap, sharing settings, and SharePoint and OneDrive service descriptions; no feature-specific licence, price or meter found.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the planned main-link expiration feature itself.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive main hero link expiration administrator policy default existing links notification renewal roadmap 571399. Opened sharing settings, shareable-links and Set-SPOTenant; found general controls but no feature-specific account.

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly identify the listed general controls as the new main-link policies described by this roadmap item.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint organization sharing links expiration SharePoint admin center CoreOrganizationSharingLinkMaxExpirationInDays main link policies. Read sharing settings, shareable-links and relevant Set-SPOTenant parameters; no explicit mapping found.

claims.claim: No source examined says that this change alters existing links on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive "main link" "expiration" default notification renew existing policies. Read roadmap, sharing settings and shareable-links; no statement about automatic changes to existing main links on this rollout found.

claims.claim: Whether the planned main-link expiry policies also cover extra links is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "main link" expiration "OneDrive" prerequisites rollout "Other links". Read roadmap, shareable-links, sharing settings and Set-SPOTenant; no statement about the new policies' application to extra links found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Owner warnings before main-link expiry are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive "main link" "expiration" default notification renew existing policies; "hero link" expiration policies notification renewal default. Read roadmap and shareable-links; no expiry-warning mechanism found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Owner renewal of expiring main-link access is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive "main link" "expiration" default notification renew existing policies; "hero link" expiration policies notification renewal default. Read roadmap and shareable-links; no main-link renewal mechanism found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Whether changing a planned main-link policy shortens existing main-link expiry is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive "main link" "expiration" default notification renew existing policies. Read roadmap, sharing settings and Set-SPOTenant; retroactivity is documented for general Anyone-link settings, not explicitly for this new policy.

claims.claim: Feature-specific rollout mechanics and prerequisites are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "main link" expiration "OneDrive" prerequisites rollout "Other links". Read roadmap, sharing settings, shareable-links and platform service descriptions; no feature-specific rollout mechanics or prerequisites found.

claims.claim: No new identity or sign-in mechanism is described for this change.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint OneDrive main hero link expiration administrator policy default existing links notification renewal roadmap 571399. Read roadmap and shareable-links; the roadmap describes expiration, not a new identity or authentication mechanism.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes no agent or automated action beyond access expiry.
claims.quote: Administrators can set policies to require expiration and enforce a maximum access duration, with separate settings for OneDrive and SharePoint. ... When access expires, the main link remains, and permissions granted directly to individuals are preserved.

claims.claim: Setting any of the four listed maximum-expiration parameters to zero removes its expiration requirement.
claims.quote: To remove the expiration requirement, set the value to zero (0).

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant also documents matching recommended-expiration parameters.
claims.quote: -CoreAnyoneSharingLinkRecommendedExpirationInDays; -OneDriveAnyoneSharingLinkRecommendedExpirationInDays; -CoreOrganizationSharingLinkRecommendedExpirationInDays; -OneDriveOrganizationSharingLinkRecommendedExpirationInDays

claims.claim: Extra links have independent settings and changing the hero link does not change or remove them.
claims.quote: Each extra link has its own audience and permission settings. ... Changing the hero link doesn't change or remove extra links.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet

claims.fix: Remove the first Before rollout bullet: its external-sharing and default-link-type controls have no corresponding rows, and the first row covers expiration instead. Do not add control rows as part of this correction.
